# ARC corpus (Architecture of Relational Coherence), by Filipe Bastos

> An independent research corpus, written in French. It is not a theory, and not a theory of everything: it holds that no single thing explains everything, because everything is relative to its context. It rests on no axiom. It is a reading, made of several elements (the figure, the nine positions, the pairs, the empty centre, the relation), applied at every scale. It rereads mathematics, physics, the living world and society from a single figure, two concentric circles with a square between them, and the constant k = 1/2 it imposes (the ratio of the radii is √2/2, whose square is ½); the operation 1 ⊕ 1 = 3 and the cadastre of nine positions (1 to 9, involution φ(x) = 9 − x, centre 4.5) follow from it. Every statement carries an explicit status: Theorem (finite computation, verified by an attached script), Fact (received science, with sources), Reading (the author's interpretation, declared as such), Prediction (dated, with its refutation criterion), Open problem. 12 volumes, version 1.0, October 2026. License CC BY 4.0. Each volume page gives an English abstract.

Main language: French. French index: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/llms-fr.txt

- [Volume 2, La Figure](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v02-la-figure/): Everything the ARC corpus says about its root figure: two concentric circles with a square between them. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_02_la_figure.pdf DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23923238
- [Volume 3, Le Code et le Registre](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v03-le-code-et-le-registre/): Three parts. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_03_le_code_et_le_registre.pdf DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23923500
- [Volume 4, La Théorie des Nombres](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v04-la-theorie-des-nombres/): The whole number theory of the ARC corpus in one book. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_04_la_theorie_des_nombres.pdf DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23923584
- [Volume 5, Les Grands Problèmes](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v05-les-grands-problemes/): What the ARC corpus has written on four Millennium Prize problems: the Riemann hypothesis, P versus NP, Navier-Stokes regularity and the Yang-Mills mass gap. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_05_les_grands_problemes.pdf DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23923765
- [Volume 6, L'Histoire de la Preuve](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v06-l-histoire-de-la-preuve/): What the ARC corpus says about proof: what it is, what it forgot, how it was received, who showed their proofs and who kept them in a drawer, and why the question of why never receives an answer. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_06_l_histoire_de_la_preuve.pdf DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23925403
- [Volume 7, La Physique relue](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v07-la-physique-relue/): What the ARC corpus says about physics, in one sentence: measurement is projection. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_07_la_physique_relue.pdf DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23925665
- [Volume 8, La Matière et le Cosmos](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v08-la-matiere-et-le-cosmos/): What the ARC corpus says about matter, the cosmos and their thermodynamics, from the smallest to the largest. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_08_la_matiere_et_le_cosmos.pdf DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23926245
- [Volume 9, Le Vivant](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v09-le-vivant/): What the ARC corpus says about life, from a thesis set out in May 2026: identity, life and consciousness are not three phenomena to be linked by a theory of emergence, but three names of a single operation seen from three disciplines. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_09_le_vivant.pdf DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23926439
- [Volume 10, La Conscience et la Peine](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v10-la-conscience-et-la-peine/): Six pieces of the ARC corpus devoted to the mind, gathered into one book. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_10_la_conscience_et_la_peine.pdf DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23926529
- [Volume 11, La Cité et le Sens](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/volumes/v11-la-cite-et-le-sens/): What the ARC corpus says about common life and meaning. PDF: https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/pdf/ARC_Volume_11_la_cite_et_le_sens.pdf DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23926716

## Short papers (French)
- [Fourier is an ARC](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Fourier_est_un_ARC_v0_2.pdf): In 1807, while Gauss engraved the remainder, Fourier filed the corpus's form: everything is a sum of closed circles, a fundamental and its integer harmonics. The multiplication table is a Fourier series on the ring, the fundamental figure a drawn series, the atom a series of harmonics (verified at build). Quantization, uncertainty, probability, entropy, the bit: five patches over a form that was refused, then admitted as technique, then stripped of its name. v0.2 adds section 1 bis: the formalisation (Dirichlet, Riemann, Cantor, Lebesgue) as a translation of the circle into the line's language, and the flat-earth legend (1828 to 1896) as the first modulo applied to history. (v0.2, 9 November 2026, in French). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Fourier_est_un_ARC_v0_2/)
- [The golden theorem](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Le_Theoreme_d_or_v0_1.pdf): The law of large numbers is not a law of chance: on the 1-9 ring, the gap between the observed mean and the centre 4.5 is exactly the weighted sum of the inverse pairs still open (an identity, verified at build). The pairs close, the ring loops, and the limit is the empty centre. The 5 is the only position that climbs and descends at once; one chance in two is a closed chance in two. (v0.1, 9 November 2026, in French). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Le_Theoreme_d_or_v0_1/)
- [Who put the cat in the box](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Qui_a_mis_le_chat_dans_la_boite_v0_2.pdf): Nobody asks how the cat got into the box. A hand put it there, and that hand knows: the truth already had a witness. The box is a fold that discards the cat's turns; the superposition is the second observer's lateness, written onto the object. Putting the error in the object is the ego refusing to see itself. (v0.1, 9 November 2026, in French). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Qui_a_mis_le_chat_dans_la_boite_v0_2/)
- [The observer is the confusion](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/L_Observateur_est_la_confusion_v0_4.pdf): Folding discards the turns, so wear becomes unreadable; the external observer is a term declared without turns and without a back, Gauss's zero carried onto a gaze; and it is this term, not nature, that manufactures the local/global confusion, in mathematics, physics, social science and psychology, where conscious and unconscious are the same pair. The free reader gives 4; the reader who pays gives 2√2. (v0.1, 9 November 2026, in French). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/L_Observateur_est_la_confusion_v0_4/)
- [Prediction is an act of uncertainty](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/La_Prediction_acte_d_incertitude_v0_1.pdf): A prediction can come true without the process being understood; the reverse engineering of an event, redone by hand down to the receipt (Patriot, Vancouver, Ariane 501, Lorenz), holds for the whole family of cases, can be refuted by calculation the same day, and makes prediction unnecessary. Popper and Kuhn turned around; the Prediction status put in its place. (v0.1, 8 November 2026, in French). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/La_Prediction_acte_d_incertitude_v0_1/)
- [Modulo](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Modulo_v2_1.pdf): Modulo: 225 years of amputated mathematics and science. The case against reduction to the remainder, with its theorems, sign-free inversions and sources. [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Modulo_v2_1/)
- [P-B-1](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/P-B-1_les_pingouins.pdf): P-B-1: the LHC penguins. Pre-registered prediction on the b → s μμ anomaly (deadline 31 December 2030), SHA-256 4079d4ae…a686. [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/P-B-1_les_pingouins/)
- [The four corners of consciousness](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Les_quatre_coins_de_la_conscience_v0_3.pdf): Air, food, movement and rest as the four corners of consciousness; the two entries of the loop; the sequence that only adds; an answer to the hard problem; added to Volume 10 as chapter 29 (v0.3, 4 November 2026, in French). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Les_quatre_coins_de_la_conscience_v0_3/)
- [The End of the Integral Calculus Illusion, v4.0](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/The_End_of_the_Integral_Calculus_Illusion_v4_0.pdf): one of the author's first discoveries (March 2026), corrected and completed; every closed form is computed from its centre, face × ½ × ⅔ × its own height; the U, the horseshoe and the torus are bars folded around their centre line (neutral fibre); Conjecture 9.2 closed (v4.0, 4 November 2026, 6 pp., in English). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/The_End_of_the_Integral_Calculus_Illusion_v4_0/)
- [Fractal, social and relational empathy](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/L_Empathie_fractale_sociale_et_relationnelle_v1_1.pdf): A reading method in five gestures (enter the era, see power and its governing code, read social relations, read the psychological state, reread with today), with examples, a control and a reading sheet; free to use (v1.1, 2 November 2026, in French). DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23926753 [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/L_Empathie_fractale_sociale_et_relationnelle_v1_1/)
- [The root carries the shells](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/La_racine_porte_les_couches_v6_7.pdf): Regime III of the periodic table read by the digital root: Z = 21 to 30, the root of the atomic number equals the root of the outer 4s + 3d electrons, 10/10, chromium included; the nine main chemical families each fall on one root from 1 to 9 (v6.7, 7 November 2026, in French). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/La_racine_porte_les_couches_v6_7/)
- [Benford without Napier](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Benford_sans_Neper_v0_1.pdf): Benford without Napier: the first digit is a count of turns, not a logarithmic law (v0.1, 26 October 2026, in French). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Benford_sans_Neper_v0_1/)
- [The Heegner numbers in the code](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Les_nombres_de_Heegner_dans_le_code.pdf): The Heegner numbers in the code: nine numbers fixed by a theorem, arranged as mirrors around closure (163 = 1-9-1). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Les_nombres_de_Heegner_dans_le_code/)
- [The native tables](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Les_Tables_Natives_v0_2.pdf): The native tables: two pages to redo with a pencil. [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Les_Tables_Natives_v0_2/)
- [The three bodies never moved](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Les_trois_corps_n_ont_jamais_bouge.pdf): The three bodies never moved: truncation, Noether and Poincaré. [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Les_trois_corps_n_ont_jamais_bouge/)
- [The basement of dark matter](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Le_sous_sol_de_la_matiere_noire.pdf): The basement of dark matter: what the measurement assumes before measuring (175 SPARC galaxies). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Le_sous_sol_de_la_matiere_noire/)
- [The remainder and the turns](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Le_Reste_et_les_Tours.pdf): The remainder and the turns: what reduction to the remainder throws away, and its cost. [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Le_Reste_et_les_Tours/)
- [How to bring ARC down](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/Faire_tomber_ARC.pdf): How to bring ARC down: the complete table of the 179 statements with Prediction status across the twelve volumes, copied with their address (v2.0, 26 October 2026). [text version](https://bastosfilipe.com/arc/dossiers/lire/Faire_tomber_ARC/)

## Author
- Filipe Bastos, born 1976 in Quebec, son of Portuguese immigrants. Biography (French): https://bastosfilipe.com/bio/

## The big questions

- [Why the Tsirelson bound is 2√2](https://bastosfilipe.com/en/topics/tsirelson-bound/): Why quantum correlations stop at 2√2: the Tsirelson bound derived without Hilbert space, by projection on the sphere, and decomposed as 4 × ½ × √2.
- [Quantum entanglement: a relation, not a signal](https://bastosfilipe.com/en/topics/quantum-entanglement/): What is quantum entanglement? Two particles sharing one relational state: their correlation is a common memory, not action at a distance.
- [Quantum physics read differently: to measure is to project](https://bastosfilipe.com/en/topics/quantum-physics/): Quantum physics without mystery: measurement is projection, randomness is the loss in that projection, spin ½ is the constant of reading. A relational reading, with its statuses.
- [The Riemann hypothesis: why the line ½](https://bastosfilipe.com/en/topics/riemann-hypothesis/): Why the zeros of the Riemann zeta function sit on the line ½: the ARC corpus reading, the centre of a pair, and what remains open.
- [Prime numbers are not random](https://bastosfilipe.com/en/topics/prime-numbers/): Are prime numbers random? No: the 6k ± 1 grid builds itself, its composites are born from four known families, and a prime is what no family generates.
- [The hard problem of consciousness: a bridge between two banks we separated](https://bastosfilipe.com/en/topics/hard-problem-of-consciousness/): Chalmers's hard problem read by the ARC corpus: consciousness as a system that reads itself, and the explanatory gap as the legacy of a historical separation.
- [Why a panic attack comes for no apparent reason](https://bastosfilipe.com/en/topics/panic-attack/): Why panic attacks strike without an object, often at night, and resist reasoning: a philosophical and psychological reading that replaces no care.
- [Left and right: two halves of one operation](https://bastosfilipe.com/en/topics/left-right-politics/): Left and right read as an unrecognised inverse pair: one articulates without operating, the other operates without articulating, and each blames the other for what it amputates in itself.
